name: Commission
description: One fitting, sent from the Punti Piccoli fitting form. The visitor has already chosen everything and measured their animal; this is the whole conversation-starter, arriving complete. There are no prices on the site, so every one of these rows is a person waiting for Sandra to write back.

status.description: Where this commission stands. Everything starts at 'new'.

from_name.description: The person's name, as they typed it.

reply_to.description: Email or phone. The form accepts either and validates loosely on purpose — a phone number written any way a person writes it still gets through.

language.description: The language they were reading in. Reply in this one.

clinic.description: From the QR code's ?c= parameter. Empty means they arrived some other way — worth knowing which posters are working.

garment_key.description: Stable key. Group and count on this.

cloth_key.description: lana=boiled wool, lino=brushed linen, trap=quilted cotton, cera=waxed canvas.

for_owner_key.description: The matching piece for the owner, in the same cloth. Empty means they took the animal's piece alone — the pairing is the whole idea, so a run of empties is a signal about the page, not about the customers.

garment.description: Human label in the visitor's language. Display only — never group on this.

neck_cm.description: 22–52. The tape on the drawing opens with this number and the animal's neck thickens with it.

chest_cm.description: 30–86. Drives the garment's depth down the flank.

back_cm.description: 22–70. Nape to tail — sets the length of the cut.

subject.description: The letter's subject line as the page composed it.

message.description: The letter body the page composed, in the visitor's language. It reads as a note from them to Sandra.

notes.description: Sandra's own notes. Not sent by the form — hers to fill in.
